links.outcome: Readability of LLM-simplified patient education materials, plus expert-rated accuracy and completeness
links.effect: All four LLMs significantly improved readability (P<0.001) to about 6th-7th grade level; GPT-4 had highest expert ratings for accuracy (4.1±0.9), completeness (4.2±0.8), and relevance of omissions (4.0±0.9).
links.quote: All four LLMs significantly improved the readability of the PEMs (P-values <0.001), reducing text complexity to an average 6th-7th grade reading level.

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks and evaluates four LLMs for simplifying reproductive genetic patient education materials using readability formulas and expert clinician ratings, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
